posts.title: Recognizing Policy
posts.description: When writing apps, we often talk about “business logic” and treat it like special code. We work hard to isolate our business logic from other parts of the code, like the view layer or framework-specific code, and we say that if you have limited test resources, testing your business logic is the first priority.
